name: golang-developer
description: Go microservices development with Clean Architecture, GORM, gRPC + grpc-gateway, Google Wire DI, NATS JetStream, Redis, MySQL. Covers scaffolding, code review, debugging, testing, restructuring, proto workflow (buf + protoc-go-inject-tag), context propagation (tenant key, NATS consumer ctx, WithoutCancel), concurrency (sync primitives, errgroup, singleflight, goroutine leaks, GORM/repo thread-safety, -race policy), observability (Zap + OTel + metrics), security (TOTP/HMAC/Vault/govulncheck), performance (pprof + allocation hotspots), and error handling (ParamError + samber/oops). Project Bootstrap Flow confirms stack choice with the user before scaffolding a new service.
